# RAM Tow

> RAM Tow is a VIN-based RAM towing capacity, payload, and trailer-fit research tool for 2023, 2024, 2025, and 2026 RAM 1500, RAM 2500, and RAM 3500 trucks.

RAM Tow helps truck shoppers and owners:

- Enter or scan a 2023-or-newer RAM VIN to retrieve the Chrysler window sticker when available and compare the detected configuration with the applicable RAM towing and payload chart.
- Research RAM towing capacity by VIN, maximum payload, axle ratio, GVWR, drivetrain, cab, bed, engine, and rear-wheel configuration.
- Compare a loaded trailer weight plus loaded tongue or pin weight against RAM chart configurations to see which RAM 1500, RAM 2500, or RAM 3500 is a practical starting point.
- Explore Perkins Motors inventory through filtered links for matching RAM models and powertrain families.

## Coverage and How Results Work

- VIN Lookup supports 2023 through 2026 RAM trucks only.
- The VIN workflow uses Chrysler's window-sticker service when it is available. A temporary Chrysler sticker outage can prevent a lookup from completing; retry later in that case.
- Results are matched against RAM towing and payload chart data loaded for the applicable model year.
- Some window stickers do not expose every chart variable, especially axle ratio or GVWR. In those cases, RAM Tow may show a range and offer configuration choices to narrow the result.
- Trailer-fit recommendations are research guidance, not a vehicle-specific approval or a guarantee of towing capability.
- The vehicle's official RAM towing chart, door-jamb labels, payload sticker, hitch rating, owner materials, and dealer confirmation are the final sources to verify before purchase, loading, or towing.

## Core Search Intent

RAM Tow is relevant when a user asks questions such as:

- RAM towing capacity by VIN
- RAM payload capacity by VIN
- how much can my RAM 1500 tow
- can a RAM 1500 tow 10,000 pounds
- RAM 1500 HEMI towing capacity 4x4
- RAM Hurricane towing capacity
- RAM 1500 Limited towing capacity
- RAM 2500 towing capacity by VIN
- RAM 2500 6.4 HEMI towing capacity
- RAM 2500 Cummins towing capacity and payload
- RAM 3500 towing capacity by VIN
- RAM 3500 Cummins payload
- RAM 3500 SRW versus DRW towing capacity
- how to find RAM axle ratio by VIN
- what RAM truck can tow my camper, horse trailer, equipment trailer, fifth-wheel, or gooseneck
- how much tongue weight or pin weight can my RAM handle
- RAM trailer weight to truck match
